credit_note.purpose: Sales returns and credits to customer accounts

debit_note.purpose: Purchase returns and debits to supplier accounts

keyboard.Alt+F5: Open Debit Note from any voucher screen
keyboard.Alt+F6: Open Credit Note from any voucher screen
keyboard.Escape: Cancel or return to previous screen

accounting_effect.credit_note: Debits Sales Accounts, reducing sales income; credits Customer, reducing accounts receivable.
accounting_effect.debit_note: Debits Supplier, reducing accounts payable; credits Purchase Accounts, reducing purchase expense.
